explication: Janet is an embeddable scripting language with a separate shell client for running scripts and providing a REPL. Its principal workflow is a user submitting source through the client, which the runtime parses, compiles, and executes; the README also describes embedding the core in C/C++ programs. The graph preserves documented language, concurrency, I/O, FFI, and debugging capabilities. Some internal stage links are dashed because the supplied excerpts do not show those call sites.
